outage.answer: Page the on-call engineer through the Duty Desk line at extension 4410; they acknowledge within 15 minutes.

enterprise-refund.answer: The refund policy doesn't cover enterprise contracts. Raise a billing dispute with your account manager, who answers in writing within ten business days.

cutoff.answer: Yes. In-stock orders placed before 2 p.m. Central on a business day ship the same day.

free-shipping.answer: No. Parcel shipping is free on orders over $500.

sensor-warranty.answer: Yes. The DS-100 is covered for three years from the date of shipment.

damaged.answer: Report it within five days of delivery with photos of the carton and the printers; we ship replacements once the carrier claim is opened.
